pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: Crimson Copper Essence is formed within scorching earth veins, refined by centuries of subterranean heat. Its crimson surface conceals a faint golden glow, carrying the essence of fire and metal. Small deposits can be discovered across red wastelands and the volcanic regions of the Nether.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Search all badlands variants, Nether wastes, and basalt deltas, usually around Y −32 to 64.
